claim: If the piezo controller is reached over Ethernet through a hub, that hub must connect only to computers meant to talk to the controller, and never to a wider corporate network or the internet.
validity_conditions: Read from NPC-D Series Digital Controller Interface Library manual, revision 6.0, for DLL 2.7.9 (sha256 88da6849...): printed page 16 (PDF page 16). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. These manuals are for the controller's software; the archive holds no hardware manual for the stage or the controller. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
